label: 被弾・撃破
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame reaction sheet EXACT 2x2 of リリス. Top-left HIT: torso recoils 25px RIGHT and 12px down, head reacts, limbs remain connected. Top-right HIT RECOVERY returns to neutral. Bottom-left DEFEAT: hovering body sinks 120px, wings close and knees fold. Bottom-right TERMINAL DEFEAT: recognizable whole character collapsed/kneeling low, original equipment and wings on body, no gore. Defeat holds, never jumps back to idle. Bright core/fins dim at defeat. No body explosion or detached pieces. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 被弾から復帰し、膝をつき両手で床を支える撃破姿勢。
issues: 被弾の上体と衣装が大きく傾くため、翼根・髪・手の所属を検収する。
復帰で裾・翼が横に広い。倒れた姿勢の両膝・ブーツと手の接地位置を確定する。
